body.title: Recovery in Arkansas. All 75 Counties.
paragraphs: Pulaski, Benton, Washington, and Sebastian counties generate the highest volume of Arkansas foreclosure surplus cases. Arkansas allows both judicial and non-judicial foreclosure. Judicial foreclosure commissioner sale surplus funds are deposited with the Arkansas circuit court, while non-judicial statutory foreclosure surplus is held by the trustee. Arkansas tax-delinquent land sales are conducted by the Commissioner of State Lands and can produce excess proceeds owed to the former owner.

The Arkansas Unclaimed Property Division, administered by the State Auditor through ClaimItAR.com, holds millions in dormant bank accounts, insurance proceeds, uncashed checks, and other assets belonging to Arkansas residents. RCG searches Arkansas circuit court records, Commissioner of State Lands records, and state unclaimed property databases for every Arkansas client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in Arkansas. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.
